title: add benchmark-lab representative runners, profiling baselines, and reporting pipeline v35
author: Aisha Rahman
description: This PR adds the next iteration of the benchmark lab components: representative workload runners for chat/completions, streaming, and embedding workloads; standardized profiling baselines (cold-start, warm, KV cache behavior) for our supported model families; and a reporting pipeline to aggregate runner outputs and baseline metrics into the benchmark lake for downstream dashboards and regression alerts. Motivation: the profiling baseline suite v35 addresses drift observed in tail latency after recent attention-kernel upgrades and gives a consistent harness for comparing quantization profiles across GPUs. Changes are grouped to keep runner logic isolated from reporting transforms so teams can consume either piece independently. Checklist: - Add representative runners for chat, completion, streaming, and embeddings. - Add profiling baselines and baseline collection scripts. - Add reporting pipeline job (Cloud Dataflow -> BigQuery) and Looker-friendly table schemas. - Wire CI workflows for periodic baseline collection and nightly profiling. - Update docs and quickstarts. Implementation details: runners are implemented as small Python harnesses under benchmark-lab/runners with a unified runner API and YAML workload manifests; profiling baselines live under benchmark-lab/profiling and emit standardized JSON lines with schema version v2; reporting pipeline is a templated Dataflow job (benchmark-lab/reports/pipeline.yaml) which validates schema, normalizes units, and writes to bq.dataset.benchmark_lab.v35_metrics. Tests and CI: added unit tests and a nightly workflow ci/benchmark-workflows.yml that runs a mocked representative workload on a cheaper instance class; integration tests included to validate schema boundaries. Rollout/ops notes: pipeline is gated behind a feature flag and will be deployed to staging for 48h smoke runs before production; baseline collection is additive and non-destructive. Related tickets: ENG-5952, ENG-6021. Links: docs/benchmark-lab/README.md and internal dashboard link placeholder. This description is a single continuous string.
commits: feat(runners): add representative workload runner harness and YAML manifests

docs: update benchmark-lab README and quickstart examples
release_notes: Add benchmark-lab representative runners and profiling baselines v35; reporting pipeline template for aggregated metrics; nightly CI for baseline collection; docs and quickstarts updated.
